args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, tickets, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and accessories
- Medications
- Travel insurance information

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and sightseeing
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip-flops
- Hat and sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Sunscreen (reef-safe)
- Beach towel
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Rash guard/swim shirt for sun protection

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Long-sleeve shirt for sun protection
- Small backpack/daypack
- Water bottle
- Insect repellent

EVENTS & SPECIAL OCCASIONS:
- Luau attire (aloha shirt/dress)
- Semi-casual outfit for nice dinners

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if desired)

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Reusable shopping bag
- Travel umbrella (for unexpected rain)
- Books/e-reader for relaxation time
- Travel pillow for flights
- Snacks for day trips
